description: This file defines the TimesheetActionLogDecorator class, which provides a decorator interface for the TimesheetActionLog entity, including methods for retrieving formatted dates, action labels, and setting associated user IDs.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for TimesheetActionLog entity providing helper methods for formatting and related entity access.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the timesheet action log formatted as 'Y-m-d'.

methods.name: getActionLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for the action, capitalized.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user associated with the action log based on user ID.
